summary: The customer called in to complain about a week-long delay in receiving their new router. The agent apologized, checked the tracking system, expedited the delivery, and assured the customer that the router would arrive tomorrow by 1 PM. The call ended with the customer accepting the resolution.

commitments.description: Deliver the router tomorrow before 1:00 PM.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite and professional tone throughout the call, handling the customer's frustration well.
